title: Verifiable staged enactment for Optimize recommendations
creator: Nina Patel
description: Implement a verifiable, staged enactment flow for Optimize suggestions that combines simulated validation, operator-escrowed approvals, and automated rollback. The goal is to let the Optimize engine propose batching/caching configs and have them applied automatically to customer workloads under strict, auditable controls. This ticket covers the controller logic, canary-within-sim simulation harness, Console approval surface, and playbook for rollback and postmortem.
acceptance_criteria: A controller exists that can take a suggestion and create a staged rollout plan with N stages and percent traffic targets (configurable)
Staged simulation: for each stage the system runs a zero-delta simulation (replay of recent requests) and produces latency/cost/quality deltas before real traffic is routed
Operator approval step: Console shows diffs, simulated telemetry, and requires explicit operator acknowledgement for >= stage 2 (configurable per workspace)
Automatic rollback: if observed runtime telemetry exceeds thresholds (latency or error SLO breach), the controller reverts to previous config within the stage timeout and records an incident entry
Auditing: every enacted change and decision (auto-apply, operator-ack, rollback) is recorded and exportable (CSV/JSON) with links to telemetry and replays
tasks: Design staged rollout schema and policy DSL (stages, traffic split, validation checks, timeouts)
Extend Optimize suggestion payload to include simulation hints and expected token-cost delta
Implement simulation harness that replays a representative window of real requests against candidate config (isolated env)
Controller: staged executor that coordinates simulation -> approval -> partial routing -> monitor -> progress
Console: UI surface for staged rollout visualization and manual approvals
Telemetry: define metrics contract for validation (p50/p95 latency, model error-rate proxy, token consumption), wire alerts
Playbook: rollback checklist and incident templates for ops and SEs
E2E tests: unit for policy DSL, integration for simulation harness and controller with mocked telemetry
comments: 2025-09-10 - Nina Patel: Kickoff. High level spike showed we can replay ~10k requests/min on a staging node using existing replay infra with ~12% CPU overhead. Decided to prototype with a 3-stage rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%)

2025-09-15 - Liam O'Connor: Prototype completed for the simulated replay harness. It returns per-stage deltas for latency and token cost. Hit a challenge: network-limited KV cache warmup during simulation produces noisier latency signals than live traffic. Proposed adding synthetic warming requests to the simulation window.

2025-09-18 - PM review (Aisha Gomez): Requested that operator approval be opt-out at workspace level for low-risk cost-only suggestions. We scoped workspace policy in policy DSL instead of hardcoding.

2025-09-22 - Design feedback (Marco Ruiz): Console wants a compact diff panel showing 1) expected cost delta, 2) expected latency delta, 3) rollout timetable, 4) required approvals. Provided mockup link: https://drive.redwood/designs/ENG-681942-rollout-ui

2025-09-25 - Security review request (sent to security@redwood): We need to ensure simulation replays do not leak customer data; recommended using request shape (schema) only and redacting payloads. Sec team flagged key rotation and audit immutability as must-haves.

2025-09-28 - Liam: Added automatic rollback thresholds: p95 latency +20% OR error-rate increase > 0.5% OR token-cost increase > 15% for more than 3 minutes -> immediate rollback. These thresholds are configurable per workspace.

2025-10-01 - QA note (Ivy Chen): Integration test failures showed race when stage timeout and operator manual override happen close together. Added a lease on rollout state to prevent double-transition. Filed small follow-up (ENG-682010) to harden lease logic.
